This issue is a reference for all improvements and context in the lifeboat project. The test and e2e workflow branch added unit tests in tests/test_inference.py with mocked artifacts and e2e tests in tests/test_e2e.py with real model files. A GitHub Actions workflow was created in .github/workflows/test.yml to run tests and linting on every push and pull request. Pre-commit hooks were configured to ensure code quality with ruff and black before each commit. Documentation was added in docs/ with api.md containing API reference and README.md with quick start information. Docstrings were added to inference.py, train.py, and upload.py for better code readability. Please review this context when adding new changes to follow the existing conventions.
